concerns.text: T015 (temperature_normalize.py) is listed as an implementation task in Phase 3, but FR-013 mandates normalization BEFORE correlation/regression. T015 must precede T018 (descriptors) and T020 (correlation) in the execution order, as US2/US3 depend on normalized data. Currently, T015 is grouped with US1 implementation but logically blocks US2 start.

T014 (provenance_validator.py) is marked incomplete/unimplemented in the text, yet T013 (clean_merge.py) claims to enforce the '≥50 unique compositions' and 'peer-reviewed source' constraints of FR-010. T014 is the producer of the validation logic required for T013 to function correctly per FR-010. T014 must be implemented and placed before T013 in the dependency chain, or T013 must explicitly include this logic.

T021 (extend validation.py with VIF logic) is listed in Phase 4 (US2) but depends on T008 (base validation.py) from Phase 2. While T008 exists, T021 is marked incomplete. More critically, T021 implements FR-008 (VIF exclusion) which is a prerequisite for T020 (correlation) and T027 (regression). The current ordering implies T021 runs after T018/T019, but VIF calculation is needed to filter features BEFORE correlation/regression. T021 must precede T020 and T027.

T028 (causal-language scanner) is listed in Phase 5 (US3) but FR-007 requires this check to run on 'all generated textual outputs'. If T028 is only implemented in US3, earlier outputs (e.g., from US2 correlation analysis) might bypass the check. The task should be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 3 to ensure it is available for all downstream reporting, or the dependency must be explicit that US2 outputs are exempt (which contradicts FR-007).

T039 is listed in Phase 2 as 'Execute Reference-Validator Agent' but also appears in Phase 6. The Phase 2 instance is a 'blocking gate', while Phase 6 is 'before publication'. This is a duplicate ID (T039) used for two distinct execution points. The Phase 6 instance should be re-numbered (e.g., T041) to avoid confusion in the dependency graph.
